name: Meridian Over-Ear Headphones
short: Closed-back studio headphones with 40 mm drivers.
description: Meridian is tuned for long sessions rather than showroom sparkle. The closed-back cups isolate without clamping, the 40 mm drivers stay composed through dense mixes, and the cable is detachable at both ends so a single failure never retires the pair.

name: Pocket DAC Amplifier
short: USB-C headphone amp that fits in a coin pocket.
description: A dedicated converter and amplifier for people who noticed their laptop output was the weak link. It runs off the host device, needs no configuration, and drives anything up to 300 ohm without strain.

name: Field Recorder Mk II
short: Two-channel recorder with locking XLR inputs.
description: Built for location work where a retake is not an option. The limiters run independently per channel, the XLR inputs lock, and the unit runs a full day on two AA cells so a dead battery stays a thirty-second problem.

name: Low-Profile Mechanical Keyboard
description: A 75% board that keeps the arrow cluster and function row, so nothing has to be relearned. Switches pull out by hand without soldering, and the aluminium case is heavy enough to stay put during fast typing.

name: Adjustable Monitor Arm
short: Gas-spring arm for displays up to 32 inches.
description: Gas-spring tension holds its position instead of drifting downward over a working week. It clamps or grommet-mounts, routes the cable inside the arm, and gives most of a desk back to the person using it.

name: Task Lamp 900
short: Asymmetric LED bar with tunable colour temperature.
description: The bar throws light forward onto the desk rather than back into the display, which is the difference between a lamp you use and one you switch off. Colour temperature tunes from warm evening light to daylight.

name: Everyday Carry Backpack 22L
short: Weatherproof 22-litre pack with a suspended laptop sleeve.
description: Twenty-two litres still counts as a personal item but swallows a laptop, lunch and a change of clothes. The fabric sheds rain, the zips are sealed, and the laptop sleeve is suspended clear of the base.

name: Cable Organiser Roll
short: Waxed-canvas roll with six elastic loops.
description: Six loops and a zip pocket, rolled and tied. It solves the specific problem of a bag where every cable has found every other cable, and it does not pretend to solve anything else.

name: Travel Tech Pouch
short: Clamshell pouch that opens flat on a hotel desk.
description: It opens completely flat so the contents are visible at once instead of excavated. Mesh on one side, elastic on the other, and a semi-rigid shell that keeps a charger from crushing a pair of earphones.

name: 65W GaN Charger
short: Three-port charger the size of a matchbox.
description: Gallium nitride internals mean one small brick replaces a laptop charger and two phone plugs. Power is shared across the three ports as devices connect, and the folding pins stop it shredding a bag lining.

name: Power Bank 20 000 mAh
short: Laptop-capable pack with a real percentage display.
description: Twenty thousand milliamp hours, 45 W out, and a display showing an actual percentage instead of four ambiguous dots. It refills itself in under two hours, which matters more than capacity on a short stopover.

name: Magnetic Wireless Pad
short: 15 W magnetic pad with a weighted base.
description: The magnets align the coil so charging actually starts, and the weighted base means lifting the phone does not lift the charger with it. A small daily annoyance, removed permanently.

name: Titanium Field Watch
short: 38 mm titanium case, sapphire crystal, 100 m rated.
description: A field watch that reads instantly in any light and weighs almost nothing on the wrist. Titanium avoids the reactions steel can cause, sapphire refuses to scratch, and the movement can be serviced almost anywhere.

name: Fitness Band Lite
short: Fourteen-day battery, sleep and heart-rate tracking.
description: It tracks the three things people actually check - steps, sleep and heart rate - then stays out of the way for two weeks. No nightly charging ritual, no notifications competing for attention on the wrist.

name: Open-Ear Sport Earphones
short: Bone-conduction earphones that leave the ears open.
description: Bone conduction rests the driver on the cheekbone and leaves the ear canal completely open, so traffic, a training partner and an approaching cyclist all stay audible. Made for running outdoors, not for a quiet office.

name: Desk Mat, Full Grain
short: 900 x 400 mm leather mat with a cork backing.
description: Full-grain leather darkens where hands rest and eventually reads as a record of the desk it lives on. Cork backing keeps it from sliding, and the edges are skived so a mouse never catches on them.
